title: 第7章 理学大儒第8章 再入天牢
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
毒先生离开天牢，对林铭来说，也只是有些许影响而已。
他照常送饭！
走到丙十七号房的时候，他脚步不由一顿，牢内关押的这一位，他印象深刻，正是之前被陈相公子收拾的那位王侍郎！
“他被送来了丙字号房？！”
“方司狱最是谨慎，除非毫无起复的可能，不然绝不可能将人转到丙字号房，这些官老爷，他都会放在甲乙两个号房，好生伺候着，以免以后生出仇怨来。”
“看样子……王侍郎已经没有任何起复的可能了！”
林铭心中思索着，手上动作没有停留，熟练地打了两勺稀粥，放入到了对方的饭碗之中，看到林铭打的饭食，王侍郎只是轻蔑地瞄了一眼，完全没有想要过来吃上一口的打算！
“没事！”
“刚转到丙字号，他还不太适应，饿个三五天之后，就是这猪食，那在其眼中都是最香的……”
林铭继续送着饭食，同时瞄准了自己今天《北冥神功》的吸取对象！
凭借蒙汗药，将对方蒙倒！
收获了一年多的功力，还有一条性命的罪孽！
要说最开始杀戮这些江湖中人的时候，林铭心中还多少是有一点过意不去，现在的他就完全没有半点不适。
唯一让他有些担心的就是身上的功德福缘！
功德福缘太少，罪孽太多，就会有劫数降临！
“还是要想想其他的办法，多做些功德之事才行！”
……
送饭结束，林铭下了值，照例，买了十个馒头，准备路上看到乞讨地，就挨个发上一个！
让他有些意外的是，今天这路上乞讨的人倒是比以往明显少了不少！
他发放馒头的时候，看到了一个熟悉的面孔，自己至少是给了他七八天的馒头了，顺势询问了一句。

“兄弟，今天乞讨的人怎么这么少？！”
“恩公！”
那人吃着馒头，口中连忙说着：
“您还不知道么？！圣上要过大寿了！”
“你的意思是人被赶走了？！”
林铭有点明白他的意思！
“差不多吧！”
那人连忙点头，口中说着：
“明面上看万年县令在城外设了粥棚，让京城里面乞讨的灾民全都去那里，施舍的粥我看了，全是水，根本看不到半点米，设置的地方又在城外，前不着村后不着店，想要找个暖和地方都没有，现在天这么冷，到了晚上肯定要冻出事来，没办法，我趁着人不注意，悄悄溜了回来，就等着恩公您下值，好混您这一口馒头吃！”
竟是这样？！
这不就是想要让这些灾民在城外冻死么？！
天子脚下，都能够发生这种事情？！
那京城之外，又是什么样的一个样子？！
哎！
林铭在心中轻叹了一声，随即询问着：
“那你晚上怎么办？！”
“还能怎么办？！土地庙，山神庙，等等地方凑合一晚上白！”
那人继续说着：
“要是运气好，碰到一两个和您一样有善心的人，说不定就能睡一晚上茅草屋！”
“嗯！”

林铭点了点头，却并没有邀请对方进入到自己的院落的打算，他并不是烂好人，知道请神容易送神难，真发善心，让其到自己的院落之中居住，想要再将对方撵走，那可就困难了！
他身上是有秘密存在的，不适合让他知晓！
“你吃着，我还有事，走了！”
林铭随手多给了他一个馒头，算是答谢他回答自己的问题，在他千恩万谢之中，头也不回地向着茶馆的方向而去！
content_en:
Mr. Du's departure from the Heavenly Prison only had a slight impact on Lin Ming.
He delivers meals as usual!
When he reached Room Bing 17, he couldn't help but pause in his steps. He was deeply impressed by the person imprisoned in the prison. He was none other than the Minister Wang who had been punished by Mr. Chen before!
"He was sent to Room C?!"
"Fang Siyu is the most cautious. Unless there is no possibility of retaliation, he will never transfer people to room C. He will put these officials in rooms A and B to serve them well to avoid any enmity in the future."
"It seems...Shilang Wang has no chance of coming back!"
Lin Ming was thinking in his mind, and without stopping, he skillfully made two spoonfuls of gruel and put it into the opponent's rice bowl. When he saw the food Lin Ming had made, Wang Shilang just glanced at it with disdain and had no intention of coming over to take a bite!
"It's okay!"
"He has just been transferred to No. C, and he is not used to it yet. After three to five days of starvation, this pig food is the most delicious in his eyes..."
Lin Ming continued to deliver the food, and at the same time, he aimed at the target of his "Bei Ming Divine Art" today!
Use the masking sweat medicine to knock the opponent down!
Gained more than a year's skill, and still had the sin of a life!
To say that when he first killed these people in the world, Lin Ming felt a little bit regretful, but now he didn't feel any discomfort at all.
The only thing that worries him is his good fortune!
If there are too few merits and blessings and too many sins, disaster will come!
"We still need to think of other ways and do more meritorious deeds!"
…
After the food delivery was over, Lin Ming paid his dues and bought ten steamed buns as usual. He was going to hand out one to each begging place he saw on the way!
What surprised him was that there were significantly fewer people begging on the road today than before!
When he was handing out steamed buns, he saw a familiar face. He had given him steamed buns for at least seven or eight days, so he took the opportunity to ask.
“Brother, why are there so few people begging today?!”
"Benefactor!"
The man was eating steamed buns and said quickly:
"Don't you know yet?! Your Majesty is celebrating his birthday!"
"You mean people were driven away?!"
Lin Ming somewhat understood what he meant!
"Almost!"
The man nodded quickly and said:
"On the surface, Wannian County Magistrate set up a porridge shed outside the city, and asked all the begging victims in the capital to go there. I looked at the porridge that was given out, and it was all water, and there was no trace of rice at all. The place where it was set up was outside the city, not in front of the village or behind. I couldn’t even find a warm place in the store. It’s so cold now, and something will happen to me at night. I had no choice but to sneak back in while no one was paying attention, just waiting for you to go out and eat this steamed bun!”
Is that so? !
Doesn't this mean that these victims will freeze to death outside the city? !
Can such a thing happen under the emperor's feet? !
So what is it like outside the capital? !
Why!
Lin Ming sighed softly in his heart, and then asked:
"Then what are you going to do tonight?!"
"What else can we do?! The Earth Temple, the Mountain Temple, and other places can just make it white in one night!"
The man continued:
"If you're lucky and meet one or two people who are as kind-hearted as you, you might be able to sleep in a thatched hut for a night!"
"Yeah!"
Lin Ming nodded, but had no intention of inviting the other party into his courtyard. He was not a bad person. He knew that it was easier to invite a god than to send him away, so he had a kind heart and allowed him to live in his courtyard. If he wanted to drive the other party away, that would be difficult!
There is a secret in him, and it is not suitable for him to know!
"You eat, I have something else to do, let's go!"
Lin Ming casually gave him an extra steamed bun as a thank you for answering his question. In the midst of his endless gratitude, he went to him without looking back.Go in the direction of the teahouse!
